_comment2: 20 multi-turn scenarios — 5 easy / 5 medium / 5 hard / 5 very hard.
_comment3: Every scenario carries a `difficulty` field. Goal checks evaluate
_comment4: the whole conversation; *_final variants target the closing turn.
_comment5: No real subagent server; run_agent_async results are mock-defined
_comment6: and injected at the scenario-specified turn.
